concerns.text: Task T005 lacks an explicit verification that the output JSON files (`data/results/semgrep_human.json` and `data/results/semgrep_llm.json`) are created and readable. The current verification only checks runtime limits and OOM logging, which does not guarantee artifact generation.

Task T006 similarly does not verify the existence and integrity of the exported SonarQube JSON files (`data/results/sonarqube_human.json` and `data/results/sonarqube_llm.json`). Without this check, downstream tasks may fail silently.
